user.title: Lights
user.description: Choose the RGB light to drive and any follower lights.

settings.title: Set-once settings
settings.description: {warning}Colour mode, Blend, Colour change speed, Time between colours, Drift smallest and largest move, Rainbow cycle time and each follower's vs main light number are on the device card after setup.

data.fixed_fade: Fixed colour fade (0 = use hue speed)

data_description.max_step: Largest hue change per command, in degrees. Above 4° looks visibly jumpy. Limits the Colour change speed and the shortest Rainbow cycle time, and for OKLab the change on any colour channel (step × 255 / 60).
data_description.fixed_fade: If above 0, every colour change takes exactly this long instead of using the hue speed.
data_description.momentum: Chance (0 to 1) that Drift keeps going the same way round the wheel.
data_description.brightness_fade: Default seconds for a brightness change.
data_description.primary_rate_cap: Most commands per second sent to the primary light (0.5 to 10). Defaults to the platform's rate (4 for meross_lan, otherwise 10). Lower it if the light drops offline while a cycle runs; fades just get slower, steps stay as smooth. Applies at once, no reload.
data_description.follower_rate_cap: Most commands per second sent to each follower light (0.5 to 10). Leave empty for each light's platform default. Applies at once, no reload.

data_description.brightness: Percent of the primary light's brightness (10 to 200; 100 = the same, above 100 = brighter but never past the light's maximum). Also the vs main light number on the device card.
data_description.offset: Degrees added to the Rainbow hue for this light.

error.primary_is_follower: The primary light cannot also be a follower.

set_brightness.name: Set brightness
set_brightness.description: Update the brightness target of an ambient light. Fades to it if the cycle is running; never turns the light on. A paused cycle stays paused unless Resume paused is set.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Target brightness, 0 to 100 percent (0 is treated as 1 %).

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Fade length in seconds. Defaults to the configured brightness fade.

resume_paused.name: Resume paused
resume_paused.description: If the cycle is paused and this call changes the brightness target, resume the cycle and fade to the new target. Ignored when the target is unchanged. Never turns an off light on.

readopt_followers.name: Re-adopt followers
readopt_followers.description: Move released follower lights back under the cycle's control. Never turns the light on or resumes a paused cycle: if it is running they get the current colour on the next step, otherwise they are adopted for when it runs.

only_off.name: Only lights that are off
only_off.description: Only re-adopt followers that are currently off (unavailable ones are skipped). Turn off to re-adopt every released follower.
